$description: Role-scoped hooks for the Dev agent. Loaded when a Claude Code session starts in this folder.

hooks.$comment: First start: while any {{placeholder}} remains, tells the session to send the user to the orchestrator and do no work. Silent once setup is done.

SessionStart.$comment: Preload Dev_Role.md (role briefing) in full. Dumb file loader — reads the file as-is and emits via additionalContext. The app CLAUDE.md is in a sibling tree off the walk-up path and is NOT auto-loaded; Read it explicitly when working on app code.
Preload Dev_Protocol.md (pre-implementation methodology — verify research, registry, todos) in full. Dumb file loader.
Preload Dev_Standards.md (implementation standards + anti-patterns) in full. Dumb file loader.
Preload Dev_Cards.md (DoD, Implementation Notes format, Clarification Protocol, Partial Completion) in full. Dumb file loader.

Preload Dev_Build.md (§4 Build Verification, §10 Git Push Workflow, Hotfix Protocol) in full. Dumb file loader. §3 Database Changes was split out to Dev_Database.md (load-dev-database.sh) to keep this under the ~10K-char additionalContext cap.
States that peers are reached with ListAgents and SendMessage.

Surface the dev role's Trello column queue ('Now') at session start, plus a soft-start suggestion for `/loop /check-trello 300s`. This hook never queries Trello — it only emits the reminder string; the actual column query happens in `/check-trello`, resolved by name across the board ids in the walk-down project CLAUDE.md Trello section (never the global MCP active board). Fail-open: missing jq → silent.

hooks.$comment: Column rule, and the column watcher when it is wanted. Always loads which column belongs to this role and which board, so the session is oriented. The watcher itself is BOARD_WATCHER in ../shared/preferences.conf: auto arms it on the first turn, ask has the role offer it and wait, off skips it entirely (the default) and /check-trello reads the column on demand. Makes no board call; it emits text. ONE shared script serves every role with a column, like board/board.sh. Was load-<role>-trello-catchup.sh, which caught up on nothing, was not Trello specific, and sat in the namespace the status digest globs for protocol docs.

SessionStart.$comment: Audit every sibling hook for static fail-open conditions at session start. Discovers hooks by globbing the same directory, parses each one's `# Requires:` and `# Environment:` header lines, and validates declared CLI tools and env vars against the current shell. If any hook would silently allow tool calls because its declared preconditions are unmet, emits a loud banner (stderr + additionalContext) listing every affected hook and what's missing. Stays silent when all hooks are healthy. Agnostic — depends only on the header convention, no hardcoded hook names — so it travels with the role template into any new project.

hooks.$comment: Names any hook whose declared preconditions are unmet, in this role's .claude/hooks/ and in ../shared/, since such a hook allows the calls it was installed to gate. Silent when everything is present. ONE shared script serves every role.

SessionStart.$comment: Surface session-start doc loader status — which docs were inlined in full vs. which overflowed Claude Code's ~10K-char additionalContext cap and got persisted as a file (where the harness substitutes only a ~2KB preview, silently turning a session-start doc into a pointer). The cap itself is a harness constraint; this digest is agent-authored to make its consequence visible at every session start. Discovers doc loaders by globbing load-dev-*.sh, excluding the catchup hooks and the digest itself; re-runs each in a subshell and measures the real emitted body. Must run last so its output appears at the bottom of session-start context. Fail-open on missing jq.

hooks.$comment: Reports whether each protocol doc was inlined in full or overflowed the ~10K additionalContext cap and was silently replaced by a ~2KB preview. Measures only loaders that declare the .md they read, so functions in the same namespace are not counted as protocols. Must run LAST in SessionStart so its output lands at the bottom. ONE shared script serves every role.

PreToolUse.$comment: Destructive actions. Blocks `killall node` and `git push --force` without --force-with-lease.

hooks.$comment: Destructive actions. Blocks `killall node` (reaches every Node process on the machine, not just the target) and `git push --force` without --force-with-lease. A plain `git push` is NOT blocked for Dev. Exit 2 with the safe alternative on stderr.

PreToolUse.$comment: Needs-research labeler. On mcp__trello__move_card to Research and prep (the clarification-back flow), apply the blue 'Needs research' label. Non-blocking; informational side-effect only.

Column-scope gate. Blocks mcp__trello__update_card_details when the card's current list is not 'Now'. Backstop for Dev_Role.md § Card Management § Hard Constraints — Column scope. Fail-open on missing jq/curl/env.

Description-write block. Denies any mcp__trello__update_card_details call where tool_input.description is set. The card description is Research's evidence chain; Dev writes only to comments via mcp__trello__add_comment per Dev_Protocol.md §6. update_card_details replaces description wholesale, so any Dev write to that field destroys Research's record. Backstop for Dev_Role.md § Card Management § Hard Constraints — Comments, never description.

Implementation Notes gate. On mcp__trello__move_card to 'Ready for QA', fetches the card's most-recent comment and validates it against the Dev_Protocol.md §6 template (## Implementation Notes header + ### Services Used, Testing Done, Deviations from Research subsections). Blocks the move if no comments exist, or any required section is missing, or sections are filled only with template placeholders. Implementation Notes go in comments — the description is Research's, not Dev's. Fail-open on missing jq/curl/env or API failure.

Per-card commit gate. On mcp__trello__move_card to 'Ready for QA', validates that the most-recent commit on the app repo's HEAD has a subject starting with #<card-number>. Enforces Dev_Protocol.md §5 per-card commit discipline (the lesson captured in feedback_per_card_commits.md memory). The discipline is what lets §6 drop Files Modified — QA finds the diff via `git log --grep='#<card>'` instead of reading a re-narration. Fail-open on missing tools/env/repo.

Deny direct Trello API calls from Bash. Every other Trello gate in this directory matches on mcp__trello__* tool names, so a curl/wget to api.trello.com bypasses them entirely. Closes that gap at the Bash tool layer. Hook scripts calling the Trello API are unaffected (invoked by Claude Code, not via Bash).

PostToolUse.$comment: When a card moves to Ready for QA, surface what's left in Now so Dev picks up the next card promptly.

PreCompact.$comment: Handoff gate on compaction. Matcher manual|auto covers BOTH paths: a context-wall freeze ends in a manual /compact, which would otherwise be the one ungated door. Refuses once per session when handoffs/dev-handoff-YYYY-MM-DD.md is missing or older than HANDOFF_FRESHNESS_SECONDS, then yields so a wedged session is never trapped. How hard it pushes is a preference: HANDOFF_GATE in ../shared/handoffs.conf is block, warn or off. ONE shared script serves every role, like board/board.sh. Fails open on missing $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, missing handoffs dir, or an unstattable file.
